selfChecks.scope: Pure input invariants only; no native compilation, world-state equivalence, Replay or performance proof.

parameters.visiblePrefix: For target f and H, actual frames <= f-H only; negative cutoff has no anchor.
parameters.predictorInputs: At most the newest two consecutive actual records in that prefix. No predicted history.
parameters.heldReference: Current held model on every retained tape, not the original used decisions of an older baseline.

cv.metadataGate: Same mode and flags; unchanged focus/directions (buttons & 0xf4). Shot is not extrapolated.
cv.fallback: No/insufficient history, other mode, unlimited, metadata edge, or invalid predicted input.
cv.limit: H<=8 plus TH09 input validity. No extra speed clamp; +/-4096 is not a field boundary.

parameters.scoring: C++ numeric equality for all fields; separate exact coordinates, encoded 12-byte equality, and non-XY ceiling.

errorUnits.directTarget: field coordinate units, both modes DirectTouch
errorUnits.joystickVector: wire velocity units, both modes Joystick
errorUnits.staleDirectOffset: distance from the last actual DirectTouch target while actual input is None; not ship movement

parameters.quantiles: Sorted values at floor(n*p), with null for an empty population.
parameters.groups: Mode and source-phase/mode partitions each cover the window; wire-edge groups overlap.

limitations: H is a hypothetical newest-actual age, not measured rollback depth or network delay. All target frames, including startup and neutral input, are scored.
No correction/resimulation count or CPU/FPS estimate. Rewinds can change previously used predictions, including turning an initial hit into a later miss.
Actual touch capture can depend on player state, focus, clipping and scheduling. A live predictor change can produce a different future actual tape.
None means disabled movement, not a target at (0,0). Target and velocity errors have separate populations; release offset is only an input-space proxy.
Full-field equality remains exact. No real input is quantized, resampled, coalesced, changed or written. Joystick and button prediction retain held behavior.
CV does not know future turns, releases or source labels. It has no physical field boundary or hidden gesture epoch and is not an approved production policy.
Recorded raw/source identities are retained claims; this script only rereads its own source and the explicit raw files, not old build inputs.

scope: Selected counts and original H8 examples from all nine runs, 18 peers and H1..8. No predictor rerun, correction/resim/FPS estimate, or production acceptance.
countMeaning: Shared group count is the denominator for both models. Absent groups have present=false/count=0. Edge groups overlap; source labels do not select samples.
errorMeaning: H8 rank is the original input-space distance/increase. Release is relative to the last active actual target, not a disabled target at zero or a ship-position error.

recorded.scope: Two real TH09 rollback worlds and exact third-world input/hash/audit/framebuffer/Replay oracle; native ABI gestures; declared frontier transport delay; all worlds in one CPU-throttled renderer; not RTC, wall-clock input response, Launcher bridge or phone evidence

parameters.inputClock: Scheduled milliseconds converted from monotonic local capture slot / 60. This is a deterministic oracle stimulus, not independent wall-clock input.
parameters.transportClock: Receiving peer monotonic simulated frontier; bounded delivery-only tail after DEV frame limit

cpuThrottle.scope: All three same-origin worlds share this throttled renderer and execute sequentially. No per-peer CPU isolation or gameplay Hz claim.

labelCoverage.method: Submitted capture-slot event <= wire frame minus declared input delay.
labelCoverage.note: Scoring strata only. Unavailable labels never remove target frames or change predictions.
